Inject navigator.serviceWorker.register(...) before </head>. MUST run BEFORE esbuild_sw so the modified HTML feeds into BUILD_HASH.

Inject single-namespace observability SDK (Sentry/OpenObserve-style). Mirrors console.* + errors + SW lifecycle to OPFS console.log. window.consoleLogs.{captureException, captureMessage, addBreadcrumb, read, readJSON, tail, clear, download}.
MUST run last — hashes the dist artifacts above to derive BUILD_HASH and inject it into the SW bundle.
